title: mkEngage Event Envelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0-compatible envelope wrapping every event on the NATS backbone (ADR-005). Payload contracts are referenced via dataschema and validated separately.

id.description: UUIDv7 event ID. Also used as Nats-Msg-Id for publish dedup and as the consumer inbox key.

type.description: Event type with major version suffix, e.g. conv.message.accepted.v1. Breaking changes bump the version in the type name.

orgid.description: Organization (tenant) ID. Mandatory on all events; consumers scope all processing to it (RULES-tenant-isolation).

actorid.description: Acting principal when applicable, prefixed by type: user:{uuid}, agent:{uuid}, visitor:{uuid}, apikey:{uuid}, system.

correlationid.description: Stable across an entire causal chain (request → events → workflows).

causationid.description: ID of the event or command that directly caused this event.

dataschema.description: URI of the JSON Schema (with semver) that data validates against, e.g. https://contracts.mkengage.dev/events/conv.message.accepted/1.0.0.schema.json

data.description: Event payload. Must validate against dataschema. Large payloads (> 256 KB) are passed by object-storage reference, never inline (ADR-005).
